notes: Fix UAT Production: TBP bam Xem loi tren notification -> modal Chi tiet loi Checklist bao 'Chua tai duoc chi tiet / He thong chua the xu ly yeu cau', Chrome console xac nhan POST /api/data?checklistTasks=1 (action getChecklistViolationDetail) -> HTTP 500. Trace xac nhan: query param checklistTasks=1 tren URL chi la chuoi trang tri phia client, server KHONG dung no de routing - dispatch that su di theo payload.action, va action goi dung la getChecklistViolationDetail (KHONG phai listChecklistTasks) - dung kien truc da chot, khong load thua toan bo task list chi de hien violation detail. Root cause that: getChecklistViolationDetail() (lib/checklist-tasks.js, them tu batch notification-violation-detail-modal 1.43.6) select() 4 cot KHONG TON TAI tren schema that - checklist_violation_records.department/branch/title (bang nay chua bao gio co 3 cot nay, xem scripts/PHF_CHECKLIST_VIOLATIONS_TEST_1.7.106.sql va toan bo ALTER TABLE sau do; noi khac trong app nhu lib/checklist-violations.js lay department/branch tu checklist_employee_assignments qua permissionEmployees(), khong phai tu chinh bang violation) va checklist_violation_tasks.current_assignee_name (khong co trong scripts/PHF_CHECKLIST_TASKS_STEP_1_1.23.sql, khong dung o bat ky noi nao khac trong toan bo code). Postgrest tra loi 'column ... does not exist' khong co statusCode rieng cua app -> lib/request-guard.js publicError() roi vao nhanh mac dinh 500 dung message evidence. Loi nay 500 cho MOI actor goi endpoint nay bat ke quyen gi - khong lien quan permission/role/current-org/score/monthly-cycle, TBP chi la nguoi dau tien bam vao flow tu Production. Fix: bo 4 cot ma khoi 2 cau select() trong getChecklistViolationDetail() - khong dung o dau khac trong frontend (chi co v.department/v.branch duoc hien co dieu kien o modal, tu dong an neu thieu, khong crash; current_assignee_name khong duoc frontend doc o dau ca). Khong sua permission/score/current-org/monthly-cycle, khong SQL/migration. Test moi scripts/test-checklist-violation-notification-detail-500.js: mock Postgrest MO PHONG DUNG hanh vi 'column does not exist' theo dung allow-list cot that lay tu SQL da chay Production (khac test cu test-checklist-violation-detail-permission.js co select() no-op nen khong phat hien duoc loai bug nay - do chinh la ly do bug lot qua CI truoc do); 13 check bao gom TBP mo notification khong con 500 + nhan dung violation/task/history, unauthorized deny an toan khong leak, employee flow va admin flow khong regression, listChecklistTasks (endpoint anh em) van binh thuong. Da xac nhan test FAIL dung 10/13 check voi loi that 'column checklist_violation_records.department does not exist' khi chay lai tren code cu, PASS 13/13 sau fix. Toan bo test Checklist hien huu (bao gom scripts/test-checklist-violation-detail-permission.js va test-checklist-monthly-cycle-snapshot-immutable.js cua batch 1.43.9) deu PASS, npm run check PASS 121 JS files.
